scope.comparison: Both complete current V3 PL baselines plus the prior V2 comparison and 2026-10-13 campaign locks; source mechanics context from R6 days 7, 10, 14, 19, 21, 22.
scope.limitations: Text editorial review; not owner acceptance, human family read-aloud, layout, publication or print approval.

upgrade_assessment.verdict: Substantive improvement over V3; retain the new coherent scenes. Bounded correction required, not another wholesale rewrite.
improvements: PL01 now leads to a ready idea for the current evening instead of asking parents to create shared memories. The after-dinner scene is concrete and idiomatic.
PL02 now has a clear activity-calendar preparation problem, recognises parents who enjoy making a calendar, and gives adults a credible role in playing.
Concrete family habits replace the abstract phrase about how much of each other is inside the family. The final child/gift comparison has gone.
Humour still comes from recognisable domestic situations and the actual activities; no preschool voice or invented developmental benefit.
upgrade_assessment.specifics_reviewed: The socks, dishes, fridge list and comic late-evening specificity are plausible scene details. They are not independent defects requiring removal.

findings.paragraph_locator: Under “Co będziecie robić”, first paragraph, final sentence
findings.evidence: Można wreszcie być osobą, która zgaduje, zamiast tą, która wszystko rozdaje.
findings.defect: Preposition “zamiast” governs the genitive. “Zamiast tą” is a case error; the nearby “być osobą” does not change that government.
findings.targeted_fix: Use a grammatical genitive construction or recast the second half; retain the adult-as-player idea.

findings.paragraph_locator: Under “Można zacząć przed końcem listy zadań”, product paragraph, final sentence
findings.evidence: Możecie otworzyć książkę, kiedy akurat macie na to przestrzeń.
findings.defect: “Mieć na to przestrzeń” shifts this otherwise concrete family article into coaching-register abstraction. The intended sense is simply a suitable/free moment.
findings.targeted_fix: Name the ordinary time/occasion directly without the abstract “przestrzeń”.

findings.paragraph_locator: “Co będziecie robić” introduction + “Kalambury na opak” teaser + closing paragraph beginning “Warto zajrzeć do środka”
evidence: Przy „lepieniu bałwana” trzy osoby mogą wyglądać, jakby uprawiały trzy różne sporty.
Kto najbardziej komplikowałby kalambury? A kto po minucie nadal tłumaczyłby, że przecież pokazywał zupełnie oczywistego bałwana?
findings.defect: The same snowman/charades joke is previewed, delivered and then explained again with two further questions. The strongest concrete joke already works in the real teaser; the repeated payoff makes the enlarged article feel padded rather than more varied.
findings.targeted_fix: Keep the real charades teaser and reduce one of its surrounding callbacks, especially the long closing one. Preserve a direct invitation to imagine doing something with the family.

keep: Both original concrete openings and current distinct article functions.
PL01 after-dinner scene, Family Machine factory image and ordinary closing list.
PL02 picture/hidden-preparation observation, adult participation and concrete habit examples.
Existing exact campaign strings and the clear three-different-days framing.
